'''Shadow Squadron''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] group which flew [[Unidentified TIE variant|TIE fighters]] and was led by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. The squadron attacked the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] during the [[Battle near the Itani Nebula]].
